geometryObservations: Three traversal verbs are taught in order, each alone first: wall-run in S1 (with an on-screen prompt over water, G-S1-a), Akano hover in S4 (wide landings, G-S4-a) and Lani-Loli phase in S9 (side view, G-S9-a). Later they recombine: wall-runs with hover gaps and totems (S8), wall-runs with phase walls (S10), and hover with double jets (S11).

Wall-run rest spacing shrinks. In S1 a solid landing (pad, round pillar, dock) separates every wall. In S8 and S10 the walls run back to back over the void with only 1 x 1 posts between them, and S10 killed the player.

Flame totems are the level's metronome. They first cross a solid balcony before the mask (O-S4-a, wait-and-go on safe ground), then cross the hover gaps (S4), then line a vertical shaft (O-S7-f, the first death), and finally fire at two heights across every gap of the finale (O-S11-a).

Landing size shrinks across the level: round pillar 3 u (S1), pond pads 2-2.5 u (S2), square pillars 1.5 u (S6), crate posts 1 u (S8). The narrowest footing is a 1 u plank bridge under dragons (P-S8-a).

Enemies are mostly light. Spirit lions drift on the line and die to a spin, so they test attack timing between jumps (E-S1-a, E-S2-a). Heavier guardian lions appear only after the mask, as whirlwind gatekeepers in corridors and on landings (E-S6-a, E-S7-a).

Enemies are placed where a new verb lands. A spirit lion waits at the first wall-run landing (E-S1-b), one hovers in a gap of the wall-run chain (E-S8-a), one leaps through the phase walkway (E-S9-a), and two hover on the C7 pad before the phase wall-runs (E-S10-a).
The 32 Nitro are geometry. They line shelves and balconies (O-S7-a) and narrow the climbing line to 1-2 u, but never stand on the required line.

Crate puzzles double as terrain. The strong crate on TNT is the +3 u step up the broken wall (G-S3-a), the bonus TNT row is the floor (P-B-b), and a TNT is the springboard to an off-camera crate (G-S10-b).
The secret hangs off the void. The hidden-gem path is a drop from a round platform at the end of the flame shaft (G-S7-c), into the space the level has taught the player to fear.
Water appears only in S1-S2. Everything after the mask is a void, so falls become certain death as the level goes on. Pond lethality was not observed.

The camera follows the verb: into-screen for wall-runs and corridors, where wall length and the next wall read best, and side view for tower climbs and the phase wall, where both phase states and the shelf spacing show.

Every hazard appears alone before it is paired. Totems are alone at the balcony and then joined by dragons (O-S7-d), spirits (S6) and the TNT springboard (O-S10-a). Dragons appear alone at the arch (O-S4-c) before they cross the plank bridge (O-S8-b).
Checkpoints get denser where the verbs combine: C7 to C8 is about 20 s around the phase wall-runs, and C5 sits between two firetraps right before the wall-run course.
geometryTransfer: Wall-run analogue. Use a `rail` along a wall (or a `vertramp` wall ride) 7-11 m long over a `pit`. In the first chain, put a 2.3 m landing pad after every rail. In the later chain, run the rails back to back with only 1.2 m posts between them, and place a checkpoint before it.

Totem metronome. Introduce the `firetiki` across a solid 3.5 m walkway (cycle 2-3 s), then across 5-7 m board gaps, then as a pair at two heights. Never pair it with a new enemy in its first appearance.
Phase walkway. A side-view stretch of 2.3 m `phasepad` planks over 2.3-4.6 m holes, with one `hopper` arcing between the wall top and the planks to set the beat.
Nitro as lane geometry. Put Nitro on the outer half of 1.2-2.3 m shelves so the line narrows to one crate, always off the required line, and pay them at the gate with the green `nitrobang`.

Strong crate on TNT as a step. Here a double jump plus a ledge grab reaches lips at about 7.0 m. To make the stack required, put the wall lip 7.2-9 m up with `multi-hit on tnt` below it. From the multi-hit top (2.30 m), a double jump and grab reach about 9.3 m, and the blast clears the multi-hit behind the player. With a lower lip the stack is optional, which still works when it only guards crates.

Hidden drop. A round platform (4-5 m) at the end of a hazard corridor with a lower floating path 3.5-6 m below for a secret. Mark it with two crates at the edge, as GR's 'two crates by the wind tunnel' does.
